[USER] User asked for advice on dealing with negative self-talk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided four tips for overcoming negative self-talk:  
1. Catch it and reframe it - Actively work to reframe negative thoughts positively.  
2. Challenge your beliefs - Question the truth of negative beliefs and seek evidence.  
3. Use positive affirmations - Repeat affirmations daily to promote positive thinking.  
4. Practice self-compassion - Treat oneself with kindness and understanding.
